comment: Conditions are expected to remain QUIET at the beginning of the forecast before the anticipated arrival of a high-speed stream from a recurrent coronal hole (CH) in the second period. Geomagnetic activity may be enhanced up to STORM G1 as this becomes geoeffective. ACTIVE spells are likely in the third forecast window as the CH influence declines. A second CH is crossing the central meridian today but any associated activity is expected beyond this forecast.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
